# How does QP-based WBC calculate joint torque after the learning strategy provides task-space setpoints?

> **Current answer:** The proposed expressions are: task-space acceleration error minimization in the constraint, inclusion of whole-body dynamics in the constraints, and joint torque calculation via constrained QP. This can serve as an engineering entry point to understand task-space inverse dynamics, but it is merely a speculation for Figure 01 and not an official architecture description.
